description: This file defines the Order class within the Opencart e-commerce platform, responsible for handling email notifications related to order status updates, including adding new orders, updating order history, and sending alerts. It interacts with models for orders, products, store settings, localization, uploads, and task scheduling to generate and queue email tasks.

classes.name: Order
classes.description: Controller class for handling order-related email notifications, including order creation, status updates, and alerts within the Opencart platform.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point triggered before order addHistory event; determines whether to send add or history email based on order status.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Prepares and queues an email task for a new order, including order details, products, addresses, and totals.

methods.name: history
methods.description: Prepares and queues an email task for order status updates, including comments and order details.

methods.name: alert
methods.description: Prepares and queues alert emails for order events, typically for order creation, including product options, totals, and comments.
